description:
Search the register of French rules that apply to websites (about 160 rules, each read in the official text).

    robot_coverage tells whether ConformRadar checks the rule automatically ("auto"), partly ("partial") or not at all ("self":
    a human must check it). Rule texts are in French; use get_rule for the full obligation, texts, penalties and authority.

    Args:
        sector: "vente-en-ligne" (online shop selling to consumers), "immobilier" (estate agency) or "entreprise" (any business site).
        theme: one of tous, vente-en-ligne, b2b, immobilier, sante, alimentation, alcool-tabac-jeux, professions, finance, tourisme,
            formation-emploi, automobile, influence, elections.
        query: words to look for in the title, obligation and legal references (French, accents optional), e.g. "avis clients", "L. 221-5".
        limit: maximum number of rules returned (1 to 200).
name: find_rules
